Allstate Commercial Fire 
California 
Explanatory Memorandum 
 
This filing package includes  two new and one revised coverage forms to enhance the Commercial Fire 
policy for Allstate Insurance Company in the state of California.  CyberOne are optional coverages which 
consist of a series of coverage components for first and third -party exposures relat ed to attacks on 
computer systems, data and subsequent recovery expenses.  Also with this filing, Allstate is adopting the 
outstanding ISO filings containing policy and endorsements.
